properties.NAME: LAFOURCHE INTERIOR
properties.CHANGE: LAFOURCHE INTERIOR (now LAFOURCHE) Parish created within Lafourche County. Creation of parishes did not abolish 12 counties established on 10 Apr 1805. Counties existed for taxing & electoral purposes, parishes took over jurisdiction of judicial matters.
properties.CITATION: (Orleans Terr. Acts 1807, 1st. Leg., 2nd sess., ch. 1, sec. 9/ p. 12; Calhoun, 85-93)
